cds-maths.research:
As a senior CDS competitive exam expert, here's an analysis for question setters regarding the Elementary Mathematics paper:

1.  **Most-Tested Question Patterns & Formats:** Predominantly multiple-choice, single-correct-option questions. Patterns include direct formula application, multi-step problem-solving (word problems), comparison-based questions (e.g., which quantity is greater), and occasionally statement-based questions requiring evaluation of mathematical properties or conditions.

2.  **Difficulty Distribution:** The established distribution of Easy 25%, Medium 45%, Hard 30% is crucial. Easy questions are direct formula recall or single-step calculations. Medium questions involve 2-3 conceptual steps, requiring careful interpretation. Hard questions demand multi-concept application, intricate calculations, or deep understanding of geometric properties, often serving as time-consumers.

3.  **Top 8 High-Yield Topics:**
    *   Percentage, Profit & Loss, Discount
    *   Ratio & Proportion, Time & Work, Speed-Time-Distance
    *   Algebraic Identities & Linear/Quadratic Equations
    *   Geometry (Triangles, Circles, Quadrilaterals - properties and theorems)
    *   Mensuration (Area/Volume of 2D/3D shapes)
    *   Trigonometry (Basic identities, Heights & Distances)
    *   Number System (HCF/LCM, Divisibility Rules, Surds & Indices)
    *   Simple & Compound Interest
